scope: Real production driver in DOM fixtures; no Android rendering claim

checks.name: Busy streaming uses metadata without exporting the long response
Busy sampling builds no second markdown/file representation
Unchanged busy polls reuse cached user binding text
Unchanged busy polls do not rescan historical message lists
Observation preserves the official document, draft and login cookie
Text streaming advances the current reply mutation revision
A stream mutation still does not export or convert its growing body
A nested body memo invalidates its enclosing transcript entry
Only the changed response rebuilds; prior user entry is preserved
A text update retains the valid message list topology
Actual stop removal plus current-turn actions yields a complete observation
Final poll shares the just-built transcript markdown and files
One final capture carries one markdown payload rather than duplicate rendered text
Unchanged final samples omit the previously captured long payload
Unchanged complete sampling does not rebuild cached content
Replacing a response DOM node with the same ID cannot reuse the previous capture
A newly generated file invalidates final content and is captured
An earlier response action cannot complete the current reply
Editing the bound prompt expires its memo and loses completion binding
A later question still invalidates the original completion task
Removing a virtualized message invalidates cached lists and restores exact binding
Changing a message role expires the cached topology
Restoring the message role reveals the current-turn response again
A route change cannot reuse reply content or complete the old task
Read-only observation never sends a message
